title: Make device failure reasons and update discovery telemetry truthful.
changes: Classify missing terminal sessions and unmatched edit targets as not_found, and edit occurrence mismatches as invalid_input, instead of treating predictable refusals as generic runtime crashes.
Keep the classification restricted to fixed known tool errors; never transmit a process ID, file content, path or command through telemetry.
Report discovery of a newer client/runtime as agent_update_available without claiming the package was installed.
Limit repeated availability announcements and missing-CLI guidance to one per release pair per 30 minutes, while preserving scheduled release checks and updater safety guards.
Cover error classification, update checks and reconnect behavior with deterministic regression tests. Publication and production rollout remain subject to release gates.
